source.title: Aster Nail Studio — An expanded photo edit
source.analysis: The saved brief specifies match fidelity. Key visual landmarks remain unchanged: the cream header, oversized serif and italic headline, rotated sage artwork, ochre divider, ruled service rows, sage studio note and compact footer. This is a targeted edit of the saved source. The two supplied photos now occupy wider, taller frames in a staggered overlapping composition, with a narrow paper-coloured separation. Mobile retains a restrained overlap while giving each photo nearly the full content width. Larger section gaps, vertically arranged service information, comfortable touch targets and a fluid headline make the mobile layout less crowded. Existing booking bindings and the native expandable studio note are preserved.
limitations: Georgia and Arial remain system-font approximations of the reference typography.
The enlarged, overlapping gallery intentionally increases page length; mobile uses a smaller overlap to keep the nail details visible.
The second photo is cropped to remove its embedded black bands, so some surrounding foliage is omitted.
Booking and booking management depend on Luster’s trusted runtime.
